title: Card golden; exit 5; no ref and no run

intent.intent_text:
---
title: Greet Almir by name
size: small
domains: [app]
---
Change the greeting in lib/greet.txt so that it names Almir,
and keep lib/greet.txt a single line.

## Acceptance
- A1: lib/greet.txt contains the line Hello, Almir!
- A2: lib/greet.txt has exactly one line.

## Verify
- A1: test
- A2: test keep

## Request
Make the greeting in lib/greet.txt say Hello, Almir! instead of Hello!
intent.test_text:
t_A1() { grep -qx 'Hello, Almir!' lib/greet.txt; }
t_A2() { [ "$(wc -l < lib/greet.txt | tr -d ' ')" = 1 ]; }
